in_marathi.name: Mahinder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Thunder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahindra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Mahadeva, the god of mountains and thunder. This powerful name evokes strength, courage, and protection. It is believed that Mahindra bestows his bearer with the qualities of a great leader, a courageous warrior, and a wise sage.
